note: Upper bounds in milliseconds (playStallsOver50 is a count) for tests/latency-browser-check.js. Set 2026-09-26 from full and quick runs in Firefox 153 and Chromium 151 on the creator's PC (AMD Ryzen 9 5950X, 60 Hz frame timing in headless browsers), with room for run-to-run noise. Click times run from the input event to the first task after the next frame, so one 60 Hz frame (16.7 ms) is inherent. gameEndLongestStallMs is known work: laying out the finished report takes about 200 ms in Firefox (BACKLOG, Input latency follow-ons). Tighten a budget when the code gets faster; loosen one only as a recorded creator decision.
